# Municipal Ordinance No. 05, Series of 2005

**Local Youth Development Council Creation**

## Summary

This ordinance establishes the Local Youth Development Council (LYDC) in the Municipality of [[Pitogo, Quezon]], defining its objectives, composition, functions, and privileges. It aims to harness the potential of the youth, encourage their participation in governance, and coordinate youth development programs. The ordinance also provides for the creation of a Youth Center and the issuance of Youth Identification Cards, as well as incentives for establishments supporting youth development.

## Key Provisions

1.  **Section 1.** This Ordinance shall be known as the "Local Youth Development Council Ordinance of the Municipality of Pitogo, Quezon".
2.  **Section 2.** Declaration of Policy - It is a declared policy of the municipality to promote and protect the physical, moral, spiritual, intellectual and social being of Filipino youth, inculcating in them patriotism and nationalism, and encourage their involvement public and civic affairs.
3.  **Section 3.** Definition of Terms - Defines "Youth," "In-School-Youth," "Out-of-School-Youth," "Working-Youth," and "Youth with Special Needs."
4.  **Section 4.** Local Youth Development Council - Establishes the LYDC responsible for formulating policies, programs, and activities in coordination with various organizations.
5.  **Section 5.** Objectives - Outlines the general and specific objectives of the LYDC, including developing youth potential, encouraging participation, harmonizing initiatives, and providing services.
6.  **Section 6.** Composition of the Council - Specifies the members of the council, including the Municipal Mayor, planning officer, social welfare officer, health officer, schools division representative, and youth organization representatives.
7.  **Section 7.** Functions of the Local Youth Development Council - Details the functions of the LYDC, such as formulating programs, coordinating agencies, providing support, accrediting institutions, and conducting fundraising.
8.  **Section 8.** Local Youth Development Plan - Requires the council to formulate and adopt a five-year municipal Youth Development Plan.
9.  **Section 9.** Youth Center - Establishes a Youth Center in the Municipality proper.
10. **Section 10.** Meetings of the Council - The Council shall meet at least once a month or as often as maybe deemed necessary.
11. **Section 11.** Discount Privileges - Grants discounts/privileges in education, arts, culture, sports, and recreation to the youth.
12. **Section 12.** Youth Identification Cards - Authorizes the Council to issue Youth Identification Cards.
13. **Section 13.** Tax Incentive to Municipality Establishments - Local private establishments in the municipality that provide the discounts as mentioned in this ordinance may claim the cost as Tax Deduction.
14. **Section 14.** Appropriations - Appropriates One Hundred Thousand Pesos (₱100,000.00) for the establishment of the Local Youth Development Council.
15. **Section 15.** Effectivity Clause - This Ordinance shall take effect within thirty (30) days from its approval.
